text: Security is an essential part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data as it travels between the user and the server. Authentication helps confirm that users are who they claim to be, usually through strong passwords or two-factor login. Developers must also validate all input carefully, because unchecked data can open the door to attacks. Common vulnerabilities include SQL injection, cross-site scripting, and weak password storage. By following good security practices from the start, developers can reduce risks and protect both their users and their systems.
